subject: CoralHealth - IAM artifacts and access validation for SOC 2 / SIG
messages:
From: Miriam Torres <m.torres@coralhealth.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Cc: security@coralhealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request: SSO/SCIM samples + RBAC mapping for SOC 2/SIG

Hi Marcus,

As part of our SOC 2 scoping and SIG review, we need a small bundle of IAM artifacts to complete our control testing. Specifically we are requesting:

- A sample SAML assertion (with attributes: NameID, eduPersonPrincipalName or equivalent, roles/claims) — you may redact PII but keep attribute names and role values intact.
- SCIM delta logs (for the last 30 days) showing create/update/delete events and the attributes changed. CSV is fine.
- A role-to-permission mapping (RBAC) that shows purpose/justification for each privileged role (least-privilege rationale).
- Any short note describing how you redaction/PII handling works for delivered logs.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these artifacts, and the preferred delivery method (secure Drive link vs SFTP)? Also please include an expected ETA; we are hoping to close this by the audit week starting 2026-11-29.

Thanks,
Miriam Torres
Director, Information Security
CoralHealth

--
Attachment: none

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Miriam Torres <m.torres@coralhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO/SCIM samples + RBAC mapping for SOC 2/SIG

Miriam — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the artifacts you requested. High level plan:

1) Attach and share an "intake checklist" we use for artifact handoffs so you can confirm scope. (redwood-iam-checklist.xlsx)
2) Produce a redacted SAML assertion sample and a companion note explaining redaction logic.
3) Export SCIM delta for the requested 30-day window as CSV with event types and attribute diffs.
4) Export role map CSV with justifications and owner for each privileged role.
5) Deliver via your preference (sftp upload or Drive) and post a secure link to the Jira ticket.

Would you prefer the artifacts in a single zip or delivered as individual files in the Drive folder? We can meet the audit-week target, but I want to confirm the handoff window — we can upload on Monday 2026-11-22 morning PST if that works.

Attaching our intake checklist here for quick alignment.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Senior Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142

--
Attachment: redwood-iam-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Miriam Torres <m.torres@coralhealth.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO/SCIM samples + RBAC mapping for SOC 2/SIG

Miriam / Marcus — quick clarifications from the security ops side:

- For the SAML assertion sample, we will include one typical Login assertion and one service-to-service assertion (if you want both). We'll redact email-like identifiers but leave the NameID type and role claim names intact. Sample filename: saml-assertion-sample-redwood.xml.
- For SCIM, we can provide a delta export spanning 2026-10-22 through 2026-11-20 (30 days) with columns: timestamp,event_type,user_id,actor_id,attributes_before,attributes_after (attributes as JSON string). If your reviewers prefer a flattened CSV with explicit attribute columns we can run that conversion.
- Role mapping: we will produce role-map-least-privilege.csv with owner, scope, justification, last_reviewed date. We'll also include a short paragraph on our role-pruning cadence.

Redaction approach: we will pseudonymize user identifiers in the sample files and provide a mapping key (control-only) under MSA/NDA if required; otherwise we will mark identifiers as <REDACTED-ID-1> to keep referential integrity.

Please confirm the delivery mechanism. If SFTP, provide upload creds or a target path. If Drive, we'll share a restricted folder and provide viewer-only links.

Laura Bennett
Security Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: saml-assertion-sample-redwood.xml (stub)

From: Miriam Torres <m.torres@coralhealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SSO/SCIM samples + RBAC mapping for SOC 2/SIG

Thanks Laura — Drive is preferred for our auditors (restricted folder with viewer-only links).

We'd like the SCIM CSV as a flattened layout if possible (the auditor team wants explicit attribute columns). The SAML sample with pseudonymized NameIDs is fine — please include an accompanying note that lists which attributes were redacted and why.

We can accept delivery on Monday 2026-11-22, but our internal reviewers asked whether you can also include a short access-validation checklist (a one-pager) that describes how you validate just-in-time provisioning and role assignments during onboarding — that helps expedite our control walkthrough.

Also, could you include a contact who can do a 15-min call during the handoff window (we have an auditor available 2026-11-22 10:30–11:00 PST)?

Thanks — Miriam

--
Delivery options provided: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB3-Redwood-CoralHealth-evidence
